content:
Hi, I'm a dev love math and physics.

I found a TODO in MatrixExponential.lean.
The theorem is useful for me, so I try to do the TODO myself. (I have searched the community and Zulip and PR, seems like no one doing this right now, but maybe just I missed).
But the way I know to do is via "A = P * T * P⁻¹" (Schur triangularization),
which is a way I learned from "Differential Geometry and Lie Groups" chapter2 by "Jean Gallier" Professor.

While doing this, I found some of the piece is missing in mathlib (or maybe I just didn't find it),
so instead of one PR with hundreds of line, I should break them down to about three PRs:

  1. #37006 BlockTriangular.pow in BlockTriangular + BlockTriangular.exp in MatrixExponential.lean
  2. Schur triangularization (the only stuff I'm not completed yet).
  3. The main TODO (as title)
    (Only PR 1 is open right now)

For PR 2,
I wonder is Schur triangularization implemented in mathlib or not,
if not, I think I saw some text about some of the stuff in EigenSpace. ... is not good to used, is this true?
If so, what is the main file should be used to handle the eigenvectors for this theorem?
Or should I choose other route to prove this,
I would appreciate any advice.

FYG Schur triangulation has been formalized in PhysLib and in #20730
The TODO det.exp has been formalized here

Thanks!
But I wonder, if so, should the TODO line in MatrixExponential.lean be removed?
Or we should port physLean lemma to this file?
Or even just rewrite it to mathlib4 style?
We should try to upstream the physlean work here, fixing any style issues as part of the PR process
Note that #20730 has seemingly been abanadoned by its contributor, and appears to resemble the physlib code. One path forward would be to address the comments there in physlib first

I've read both #20730 and the physlib proof.
The physlib version specializes BlockTriangular to id, while my PR1 #37006 proves the general b version.

I'd be happy to upstream the code in physlean with the generalized version to here.
Thanks for starting with a small PR

hakii6, Tseng ha scritto:

Thanks!
But I wonder, if so, should the TODO line in MatrixExponential.lean be removed?
Or we should port physLean lemma to this file?
Or even just rewrite it to mathlib4 style?

I'm definitely planning to upstream the det.exp file to mathlib, just waiting for #20730 to be refactored and merged.

I've read the whole #20730 and the code in physLean, porting the code to Mathlib style is beyond my current familiarity with Mathlib conventions.
I'd prefer to approach this through several small PRs instead, that might also unblock the det.exp upstream work.
Would that work, or is there a reason to keep #20730 as the main path?

hakii6, Tseng said:

I'd prefer to approach this through several small PRs instead, that might also unblock the det.exp upstream work.

This is perfect, just make sure to attribute the work where it is inspired from the other PR.
FYI #39139 now reimplements the original #20730 closer to mathlib standards
